titulo: If someone sent you this, they will dread Monday with you
alt: A short film for Stories, no voice. A dark blue room. Two small block figures sit side by side on a bench with a clock on the floor that reads 9:00 and then 9:01. They lean toward each other and their eyes turn happy. The text stays on screen: if someone sent you this, they will dread monday on the couch with you.
